description: This PHP class 'JobTitleService' provides methods for managing job titles and related entities within the OrangeHRM system, including retrieval, creation, deletion, and normalization of job title data.

classes.name: JobTitleService
classes.description: Service class for managing job titles and related entities in OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getJobTitleDao
methods.description: Retrieves the JobTitleDao instance, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: getJobTitleList
methods.description: Returns a list of job titles, optionally only active ones.

methods.name: deleteJobTitle
methods.description: Flags specified job titles as deleted.

methods.name: getJobTitleById
methods.description: Retrieves a JobTitle entity by its ID.

methods.name: getJobSpecAttachmentById
methods.description: Retrieves a JobSpecificationAttachment entity by its ID.

methods.name: getJobTitleArray
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized job title models.

methods.name: getJobTitleArrayForEmployee
methods.description: Returns an array of normalized job title models for a specific employee.
